_help: Angles are degrees. 0 = limb hangs straight down, 90 = points to the right of the screen, -90 = to the left, 180 = straight up. Arms/legs are [upper, bend]: 'upper' is the shoulder/hip angle, 'bend' is how much the elbow/knee turns from there. body = lean, head = head tilt, y = move the whole body down (+) or up (-). Moves are keyframes (t in seconds) that blend smoothly and repeat when loop is true.
